Are you a qualified actuary ready to step into a role where technical excellence meets commercial strategy? Do you thrive at the intersection of pricing leadership, portfolio performance and senior stakeholder influence - in one of the world's most international reinsurance environments? If this sounds like you, Swiss Re wants to hear from you.

As a Senior Actuary in the Continental Europe Market Unit, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's Life & Health business - shaping strategy, driving portfolio performance and acting as a trusted actuarial voice across markets. This is a role that blends deep technical expertise with real commercial impact, offering you the opportunity to lead, influence and make a difference at scale.

· Act as Chief Actuary for one or more Continental European markets, providing technical leadership and oversight of pricing decisions, referrals and key actuarial assumptions
· Monitor portfolio performance continuously - identifying emerging opportunities and risks, and supporting the design and execution of value-enhancing management actions
· Partner cross-functionally with Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation and Portfolio Management teams to identify and unlock opportunities to enhance portfolio value
· Influence strategic decisions by acting as a trusted counterpart to Inforce Optimisation and Portfolio Management teams - bringing constructive challenge and sharp actuarial insight
· Lead actuarial assessments supporting repricing initiatives, recaptures, in-force transactions and other high-impact strategic projects
· Contribute to client discussions, transaction structuring and negotiations, bringing both actuarial rigour and commercial perspective to the table
· Support governance processes through referral reviews and independent actuarial challenge, ensuring robust decision-making frameworks
· Connect the dots across the actuarial control cycle - building an end-to-end understanding of the business and feeding consistent insights back to the relevant teams
· Represent your markets and contribute to selected Continental Europe cross-functional initiatives, broadening your impact beyond your core portfolio
· Coach and support less experienced actuaries, actively contributing to a culture of technical excellence and continuous development across the organisation

You will join a vibrant and highly collaborative Continental Europe actuarial community, working closely with colleagues across Client Management, Underwriting, Valuation, Pricing and Portfolio Management. The team is deeply embedded in Swiss Re's Life & Health business and plays a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of one of the most diverse and dynamic reinsurance portfolios in the region.
This role offers broad exposure to strategic initiatives, senior stakeholders and a rich variety of Life & Health products and markets - making it an exceptional opportunity for an actuary who is ready to grow their leadership footprint in a truly international setting.

We are looking for a commercially minded, technically strong actuary who brings both depth of expertise and the confidence to challenge and influence at the most senior levels. You are someone who can translate complex actuarial insights into clear business recommendations, build trusted relationships across functions, and lead initiatives independently in a fast-paced, international environment.

s.h: We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements
s.t:
· Qualified actuary (SAV, DAV, FIA, FSA or equivalent) with significant actuarial experience in life insurance, health insurance or reinsurance
· Strong technical grounding in pricing, valuation, portfolio management or related actuarial disciplines, with a demonstrated ability to assess portfolio performance and translate findings into actionable business recommendations
· Proven stakeholder influence - a track record of constructively challenging and engaging senior stakeholders, driving outcomes across organisational boundaries
· Commercial acumen - a solid understanding of reinsurance value drivers and the ability to bring commercial judgement to actuarial work
· Excellent communication skills - the ability to present complex actuarial topics clearly and compellingly to both technical and non-technical audiences, combined with fluency in English

s.t:
· Experience in portfolio management, in-force management or portfolio steering
· Background in supporting client negotiations and transaction structuring
· Proven leadership qualities including the ability to inspire, engage and empower a team with diverse professional backgrounds and experience, with a passion for developing others
· Strong understanding of various valuation methods including IFRS17
· Additional European language skills - particularly German, French, Italian or Spanish

About Ethos

About the role Ethos is looking for an experienced actuary to lead our mortality analytics and actuarial assumption modeling. You will serve as the company's expert on mortality, translating complex insights into strategies that improve our product competitiveness and financial integrity.

We're seeking someone with a strong foundation in life insurance mortality modeling who brings deep actuarial expertise and enjoys tackling open-ended problems. Building new methodologies where playbooks don't exist.

You're energized by the chance to apply AI and emerging techniques to problems insurance companies have solved the same way for decades, and you know how to align actuarial rigor with product velocity across finance, product, and underwriting teams.

If you're excited about pushing the boundaries of actuarial science while maintaining rigor and reliability, we'd love to hear from you. Duties and Responsibilities:
Own mortality-related assumptions and other actuarial inputs across product development, forecasting, and financial reporting.
Lead the development and maintenance of expected mortality models, assumption frameworks, and experience studies.
Leverage leading data points, such as post-issue audit data and mortality risk scores, to predict mortality before experience is fully credible.
Monitor actual-to-expected mortality experience and work collaboratively with underwriting and data science teams.
Design and complete protective value studies to quantify the mortality lift of underwriting requirements.
Quantify the impact of applicant behavior on overall expected mortality and mortality curve shapes.
Utilize AI to accelerate pace of insights and maximize business impact.
Serve as the Ethos mortality subject matter expert, advising senior leaders internally and engaging with key partners externally, translating technical work into actionable business recommendations.

FSA or near-FSA designation preferred; experienced ASA candidates considered.
5+ years of experience in life insurance actuarial roles with exposure to both mortality and underwriting models.
Proven ability to translate third-party data, post-issue audits, and other leading indicators into expected mortality outcomes.
Experience with assumption setting for life insurance pricing, forecasting, or valuation across a broad range of products.
Track record of partnering with finance, product, and underwriting teams—aligning actuarial rigor with business velocity.
Familiarity with modern data tools and pipelines (SQL, dbt, Snowflake, etc.).
Strong statistical modeling skills in R or Python.
Proficiency with Excel and actuarial modeling tools.
Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical work for non-actuarial audiences.
